headline: Flutterwave Appoints Guo Songmei to Lead Asia-Africa Trade Expansion
summary: Payments firm Flutterwave appointed Guo Songmei as Regional Vice President for Greater China and Asia to develop enterprise commercial partnerships and payment infrastructure.
why: Flutterwave is one of Africa's valuable fintech scale-ups; expanding cross-border payment corridors facilitates trade flows between Asia and African economies.
